svg.text: The leader is the sole dispatcher; each @ assigns one single-turn task, and members return results to the leader.

svg.text: Users can directly @ a member to intervene; member-to-member @ creates no run and returns as a suggestion to the leader.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro SC', 'PingFang SC', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The per-turn hop limit (default 64) only prevents runaway @ loops; it does not decide who participates.
